content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, fingers brushing against his wrist ||| "You think this is all I have to say?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing my grip on The Answer ||| "I won't answer until I understand the truth."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, holding the weight of my words ||| "You make me question everything I believed to be true."  
REVERSAL ||| Firmly take control of The Answer, shifting the power dynamics ||| "I’ll decide what happens next, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Close my eyes, breathing deeply, feeling the tension rise ||| mm
